title: Pilot module end-to-end: "Containers & environments" + 1 gated worked example
context: Before building all six modules, the project must prove the complete flow — template, CI harness, and data gate — end-to-end on one pilot module. The 'Containers & environments' module is chosen because it is the highest-leverage, most self-contained skill, it exercises the CI harness that all later modules depend on, and its worked example can use the lowest-risk allowed source (DepMap CC-BY 4.0 or fully synthetic data), making a real, low-risk end-to-end pass reachable without waiting on a teaching partner. Depends on: framework-001, datagate-002, template-004, container-ci-005, reviewers-003.
objective: Author the 'Containers & environments' module end-to-end following the module template, with Bloom-aligned learning objectives, a lesson with all assertions cited, a runnable pinned-container exercise, one gated worked example on DepMap CC-BY 4.0 or synthetic data, a reproducibility checklist/takeaway, formative assessment, and instructor notes; pass all four reviewer sign-offs and CI; deliver to >= 1 learner or record a self-run workshop.
acceptanceCriteria: Module complete to the template: 3-6 Bloom-aligned learning objectives, lesson narrative with all assertions cited, runnable pinned-container exercise, one gated worked example, checklist/takeaway, formative assessment, and instructor notes.

Worked example uses the lowest-risk allowed source (DepMap CC-BY 4.0 or fully synthetic data), with a committed PASS gate artifact (permitsDerivatives: true, non-identifiable); data fetched at runtime, no raw data committed.
Container builds (Docker + Apptainer) and exercise/example pass in CI (green in last scheduled run).
Signed off by Data & licensing reviewer, Domain reviewer, Educator reviewer, and Technical reviewer.

Taught or self-delivered to >= 1 learner or cohort (self-run workshop fallback acceptable) with the outcome recorded in the outcome ledger (outcomes/<event-id>.json) — or, if no learner yet, marked delivered-pending with the specific blocker surfaced.
No biological/clinical conclusion presented as a finding; module labeled 'teaching example — not a finding, not advice.'
resources: conda/mamba documentation; The Carpentries lesson format
output: A complete 'Containers & environments' module committed to the project repo (lesson, exercise, worked example, checklist, assessment, instructor notes), with a committed PASS gate artifact for its dataset, CI green (Docker + Apptainer), and all four reviewer sign-offs; outcome ledger entry for the first delivery.
